# pushward_org_tag_devices (Resource)

The devices that carry one tag. Declare at most one per tag; tags without one keep the devices set in the PushWard console or app.

`devices` replaces the tag's devices, including ones tagged in the app or console: an apply takes the tag off every device the set leaves out. A device that unregisters drops out of the set, so build the set from `data.pushward_org_devices` rather than hard-coding device ids. Destroying it takes the tag off its devices.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pushward_org_devices" "all" {}

# The pager tag on every device of the on-call group's members. Built from
# the data source, so a device that unregisters simply drops out.
resource "pushward_org_tag_devices" "pager" {
  tag_id = pushward_org_tag.pager.id
  devices = [
    for d in data.pushward_org_devices.all.devices : { user_id = d.user_id, device_id = d.device_id }
    if contains(pushward_org_group.oncall.member_ids, d.user_id)
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `devices` (Attributes Set) Every device that carries the tag, at most 500. Empty takes it off every device. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))
- `tag_id` (String) The tag. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The tag id.
- `org_id` (String) The organization the resource belongs to, that of the provider's org admin key when the resource was created or imported. An org admin key of another organization is an error, not a plan that creates the resource again there.

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Required:

- `device_id` (String) Device id.
- `user_id` (String) The device owner's user id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By tag id.
terraform import pushward_org_tag_devices.pager 9a7d3c21-4e5f-4b8a-b2c1-6d0e9f8a7b35
```
